title: Agentic orchestration with governance
label: Reference architecture: how I approach this

layers.name: AI clients
layers.note: Where requests enter: assistants, workflows and applications.

layers.name: Orchestration
layers.note: Routes each request to the agent or tool that should handle it.

layers.name: Governance and guardrails
layers.note: Policy, access control and checks applied before and after each step.

layers.name: Tools and data
layers.note: The services and data stores the agents may use.

layers.name: Observability
layers.note: Traces and logs for every request, so behaviour can be reviewed.

textAlternative: Five layers from top to bottom. Clients send requests to an orchestration layer. A governance and guardrails layer checks each step. Approved steps reach tools and data. An observability layer records every request across all layers.
summary: Every request passes a policy layer before it reaches a tool, and every step is recorded.
